_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

enable_the_master_trials_dlc.description: Enables items and locations exclusive to the Master Trials DLC.

enable_the_champions_ballad_dlc.description: Enables items and locations exclusive to the Champions' Ballad DLC.

randomize_starting_tower.description: Selects from one of most of the 15 Sheikah Towers to start with. If disabled, always starts with the Great Plateau Tower.

shuffle_shrine_chests.description: Include the chests in shrines as locations.

shuffle_trial_of_the_sword.description: Include Trial of the Sword chests and section completions (Beginning, Middle, and Final) as locations. Requires enabling The Master Trials DLC.
